methodology.signalData: frozen production evaluators on completed midpoint candles
methodology.executionData: OANDA practice historical MBA; long ask entry/bid exit; short bid entry/ask exit
methodology.ambiguity: stop first when both levels occur in the same strategy-timeframe candle
methodology.sensitivity: extra spread is centered on midpoint: half worsens entry and half worsens the executable exit side

parity.note: Known headline win rate differs under conservative stop-first ambiguity handling; PF/count remain the parity gate.

portfolio.caveat: Frequencies are arithmetic counts, not an independence claim; pair correlation still requires portfolio-level testing.
